title: VAP Incidence and Adequation to SRLF 2017 Diagnostic Among an Intensive Care Medicine Service for the Period 2022 à 2024
official: VAP Incidence and Adequation to SRLF 2017 Diagnostic Among an Intensive Care Medicine Service for the Period 2022 à 2024
summary: The goal of this observational study is to to analyze respiratory samples performed in mechanically ventilated ICU patients and to assess whether the SRLF criteria for defining VAP were respected among patients admited to the Intensive care medicine at a regional hospital en France
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adults ≥ 18 years
* Hospitalization in Intensive care unit for the period between 01/01/2022 and 31/12/2024
* Intubation and mechanical ventilation for \> 48h
* Positive respiratory sample

Exclusion Criteria:

* Decision of therapeutic limitation
* Organ donors
* Patient refuse to participate
